generate_clip_scores_dataset: run the script to generate and write CLIP scores for all DenseCaptionedImage entries in the dataset
get_clip_model: get the pretrained openai clip-vit-base-patch32 model and processor for image-text similarity scoring
get_clip_scores_for_dci: compute CLIP similarity scores between a DenseCaptionedImage summaries and negatives against its image
review_get_clip_scores: review the get_clip_scores function that computes image-text logits for summaries and negative captions
review_generate_and_write_clip_scores: review the generate_and_write_clip_scores function that iterates over all dataset entries and writes CLIP scores
